full_judgment: 5. The learned Counsel for the petitioner upon placing the judgment of the High Court Division and the other materials on record submitted that the appellate Court on detailed discussions arrived at the finding that pre-emptor's mother's name does not appear in S.A. Khatian Nos. 750 and 774 and in the parcha No. 544 and as such question of pre-emptor's being owner of the land of plot No.911 does not arise and thereupon set aside the judgment and order of the trial Court. It is seen from the judgment of the appellate Court that the said Court totally left out of consideration the oral evidence led by the pre-emptor in support of his being the owner of the land of plot No. 911 and that the said plot is contiguous to the plot No.909 land of which sought to be pre-empted. The High Court Division on independent discussions and consideration of the evidence has arrived at the finding that the pre-emptor is (miler of the land of plot No.91 I and that the said plot is contiguous to plot No.909 land of which sought to be pre-empted and limiter held that the pre-emptor by reliable evidence has successfully established that he is contiguous land owner or. the plot land of which sought to be pre-empted.
